Ariana: Weekly account-health check-in for AcmeCorp — quick error-rate breakdown (week Mar 9–15). Seeing 2.7% overall error rate, spike on Tue. Top contributors: 5xx 54%, timeouts 30%, rate-limits 16%. Can SRE + CS confirm top endpoints and impact? /cc @Mike @Jess
Mike: Pushed a quick query to dashboards, short summary below. attaching counts.
Mike: ```
Top failing endpoints (by error count):
1) POST /v1/generate - 1,420 errors (51% 5xx, 35% timeouts)
2) POST /v1/chat/stream - 620 errors (70% timeouts)
3) GET /v1/embeddings - 310 errors (60% 429 rate-limit)
4) POST /v1/reload-model - 120 errors (80% 5xx)
5) POST /v1/upload - 85 errors (60% timeouts)
```
Jess: Thanks. Renewal risk flag? Acme has upcoming Q2 renewal. Any UX complaints / escalations from AE?
Sam: AE reported two onboarding sessions blocked by timeouts on chat/stream, they deferred feature demo. Customer annoyed.
Ariana: That increases risk — add to renewal brief. Action items: (1) SRE throttling + retry tuning for /chat/stream, (2) prod canary fallback to smaller model for /generate during high-latency windows, (3) Sales to offer enablement session post-fix. Who picks (1)?
Mike: I'll take (1). I'll open #INC ticket and run a short-term rate-limit increase for the AE org to reduce 429s. Created ticket: INC-4521
Sam: I'll tell AE to pause demos until we confirm fix and offer a recording.
Jess: Please add error trend graph to renewal slide deck — ping me when the rate goes under 1.5%.
Ariana: Noted. @deploy-bot any deploys around Tue 10:12 UTC?
deploy-bot: deploy/infra (infra-team) completed: 2024-03-12T10:08:11Z — no model rollout flagged.
Mike: Logs indicate two transient GPU OOMs around Tue 10:10 causing 5xx on /reload-model and cascading timeouts on /chat/stream. We're adding KV cache limits + retry budget.
Ariana: Perfect. I'll follow up in the renewal doc and schedule a 1:1 with AE. Closing thread after actions confirmed. :white_check_mark:
